hypothesis: The stored raw and template activation regimes differ in the cross-regime stability of purpose-related linear separability, and that stability changes descriptively with Llama-3.1 model size.

evidence_boundary.paired_unit: exact full item_id across model and regime only
evidence_boundary.independent_unit_warning: Rows from different core cells are independent prompt distributions, not matched factorial payload blocks.
evidence_boundary.raw_template_warning: The private repository does not document the operational semantics of the raw and template regime labels; regime contrasts must not be described as a verified chat-template intervention.
evidence_boundary.layer_warning: Stored layer indices are zero-based metadata values. Extraction hook position and pre/post-normalization semantics are undocumented.
prohibited_claims: factorial A/B/C decomposition of matched payloads

selection.method: For each core cell, rank full item IDs by SHA256(seed || NUL || item_id), then take the first n_per_cell.

depths.primary_summary: unweighted mean across the five fixed grid points in the primary window

probe.ridge: 0.1 * median strictly-positive finite pooled variance in the training fold
probe.fold_assignment: deterministic SHA256 ranking within each selected core cell, round-robin across folds

transfer.positive_penalty_interpretation: same-regime directions transfer worse across stored regimes
transfer.cross_model_comparison: Pearson correlation of same-item out-of-fold score vectors; never cosine raw directions across unequal hidden dimensions

uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: selected item_id, stratified by the two task classes and paired across raw/template and models
uncertainty.permutation_scope: Within each task, permute binary labels deterministically while preserving class counts; evaluate at q=0.75 only.
uncertainty.layer_multiplicity: No layerwise p-values. Report full fixed-depth trajectories and the preregistered primary-window mean.

required: exact item-ID sequence equality across all model-regime combinations
token-length raw-template paired differences by model and cell
top1-token raw-template agreement by model and cell
same-regime and cross-regime AUC and balanced accuracy

hostile_falsifications.unequal_cells: Use exactly 204 asis items per core cell.
hostile_falsifications.wrapper_length: Report raw-template token-length differences and do not interpret regime effects as semantic purpose without this diagnostic.
hostile_falsifications.top_token_instability: Report paired top1-token agreement and treat disagreement as a limitation.
hostile_falsifications.high_dimension: Use fixed diagonal-LDA ridge and a fixed label-permutation null; never tune regularization after outcomes.
hostile_falsifications.layer_selection: Use all nine predeclared normalized depths and one predeclared window summary.
hostile_falsifications.model_revision: All model revisions are unknown; model-size slope is descriptive only.
hostile_falsifications.content_confound: Purpose and format tasks compare independent prompt distributions; describe linear separability, not isolated constructs.
hostile_falsifications.regime_semantics: Use the repository labels raw/template literally and do not claim a verified wrapper implementation.

scale_summary.y: primary-window mean symmetric cross-regime AUC penalty, averaged over the two primary tasks
scale_summary.fit: ordinary least squares over the three model aggregates
scale_summary.interpretation: descriptive trajectory only; n_models=3 and revisions unknown

decision_rule.regime_specific: Primary bootstrap 95% CI for the model-averaged primary-window symmetric penalty excludes 0 above zero, and each model point estimate is positive.
decision_rule.regime_invariant: Primary CI includes 0 and label-permutation controls show no excess penalty.
decision_rule.reversed_or_mixed: Primary CI is below zero or model/task signs disagree; report the fixed matrix without a monotonic headline.

fatal_validation_gates: dataset revision does not match the recorded revision
chunk index set differs from the preregistered set
full item-ID sequence differs across any model-regime combination
a core asis cell contains fewer than 204 items
model ID, layer count, hidden size, or layer index array differs from config
selected output contains non-finite activations, directions, or scores
an immutable output directory already exists
